message: 闇からのまなざし
All alone together in a dark place like this.
Wait, what am I thinking? We're on patrol right now. Besides, just because we're alone together doesn't mean anything's going to happen.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yeah?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Um, well, you know. W-we're all alone together, aren't we.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-all alone together!」
N-no, Nanaka probably didn't mean it like that.

name: Nanaka
message: 「E-eh, ah, I-I didn't mean it like that.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I know.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-it's fine. The way we are now, we can at least buy enough time for everyone to rush over.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A-ah, r-right. Ahaha.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn?」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's a big one.」
Pasta!?
A two-on-one against a Demon General puts us at a disadvantage.

name: Synn
message: 「Contact everyone!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Eh, ah, yeah.」

name: Sheba
message: 「Meow!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Demons!」
Damn it! Their presences were masked by the huge one, so I didn't notice!

name: Pasta
message: 「Whaaat, the Student Council, nya!?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Doesn't look like we've got time to hide.」

name: Pasta
message: 「And right when we were saying it's our last one, what rotten luck, nya.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-your luck just ran out, pal! Prepare yourself!」
The demonic energy erupting from Pasta reverberates against my skin.
What intense pressure!

name: Pasta
message: 「What, there's only two of you, nya! Victory is guaranteed like this, nya!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What's your deal? Even though you lost to us before.」

name: Pasta
message: 「If we outnumber you, we won't lose, nya.」
As frustrating as it was, Pasta was right.
Living up to the title of one of the Seven Demon Generals, Pasta was overwhelming against the two of us.
Had I really been relying on everyone's help this much?

name: Pasta
message: 「Both of you, hurry up and become mincemeat, nya.」
Perhaps imbued with magic power, Pasta's claws emitted an eerie glow.
Now while their numbers are small is our chance... if more of their allies show up, we won't stand a chance.

name: Synn
message: 「Guh... We have no choice but to fight! Nanaka!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka?」
Illuminated by the light of the alleyway, Nanaka's face was covered in sweat across her forehead, looking pained.

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka?! Are you okay?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-It's nothing, I'm fine!」
She was trembling, almost as if hugging herself.
Her steps as she backed away were unsteady.
I stepped in front of Nanaka.

name: Nanaka
message: 「I can fight! I-I'm okay!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't push yourself. Everyone will be here soon.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Here it comes!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Hiiissssss!」
